COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

2. Which statement about Community Needs is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Community Needs never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Community Needs with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Community Needs as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Community Needs.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

4. Which statement about Intercultural competence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Intercultural competence as rumours only.
   B. Explain Intercultural competence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Intercultural competence.
   D. Say Intercultural competence never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr.
   C. Explain Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision Making 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Intr never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Self- Awareness in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness in the Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Self- Awareness in the Community as rumours only.
   C. Explain Self- Awareness in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Awareness in the Community.

7. Which statement about Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision.
   D. Treat Self-Awareness in the Community 2.2 Conflict Resolution 2.3 Responsible Decision as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Responsible Decision Making is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Responsible Decision Making never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Responsible Decision Making.
   C. Explain Responsible Decision Making with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Responsible Decision Making as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Conflict Resolution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Conflict Resolution.
   B. Say Conflict Resolution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Conflict Resolution as rumours only.
   D. Explain Conflict Resolution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Action Research never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Introduction to Action Research with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Introduction to Action Research as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research.

11. Which statement about Concept of Community Service Learning is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Concept of Community Service Learning with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Concept of Community Service Learning never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Concept of Community Service Learning.
   D. Treat Concept of Community Service Learning as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp.
   C. Treat Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp as rumours only.
   D. Explain Introduction to Action Research 3.2 Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Imp with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Action Research and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Problem Identification 3.3 Designing and Implementing an Intervention 4.0 Social and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Problem identification and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Designing and Implementing an Intervention and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
